status: 설계 명세. SDK·시뮬레이터·서버가 구현 또는 시험 완료되었다는 뜻이 아님.
composition: One edge application process with an AI control module and a backend-owned communication/storage SDK. No new network service or local IPC protocol is required. Worker threads perform network I/O outside the control loop.

runtime_gate.decision: Choose SDK implementation language and binding jointly from verified board support. Backend can implement protocol fixtures, simulator and server immediately on PC; no unverified Python/C++ board support is claimed.

interfaces.name: restore
interfaces.input: registered device/zone IDs; protected storage configuration
interfaces.output: last checkpoint and checkpoint_version, local_revision, persisted event/count/pauses/policies; pending messages remain SDK-owned
interfaces.rule: AI validates its checkpoint codec. Restart clears continuous stop accumulation and requires existing RESTART/resume flow. Unknown checkpoint version blocks automatic output.

interfaces.name: commit_transition
interfaces.input: operation_id; expected_local_revision; checkpoint_version and serialized AI checkpoint; EventRecord / DeviceSnapshot drafts; event/result/image-job/attempt changes
interfaces.output: COMMITTED | DUPLICATE | CONFLICT | FAILED; committed local_revision and generated IDs
interfaces.rule: One SQLite transaction saves checkpoint, attempt/count changes, immutable message envelope+payload and outbox, photo-job intents. SDK is sole DB writer. Same operation_id+same request returns original result; different body conflicts. Uncertain commit is queried/retried under same ID. operation_id is created by the caller and retained until the result is known. Allocation of device_seq and message IDs is in the same SDK transaction; retry returns the original IDs.

interfaces.name: publish_current_state
interfaces.input: fresh DeviceSnapshot draft and measured fps, with original observation time
interfaces.output: latest cached snapshot; heartbeat every5000ms using network contract
interfaces.rule: Does not invent new camera observation time or extrapolate continuous_stop_ms when AI stalls. SDK supplies pending_message_count/storage_ok. Serialize heartbeat snapshots with state updates and device_seq allocation.

interfaces.name: take_command
interfaces.input: nonblocking poll of bounded, deduplicated command inbox
interfaces.output: canonical Command or none, with remaining transport expiry
interfaces.rule: SDK checks identity/schema/transport expiry/dedup. AI owns final event/mode/policy/clock/pause/token checks and physical execution. STOP handling must not wait for network or photo work; no silent command drop on full queue.

interfaces.name: commit_command_result
interfaces.input: command_id and actual result/error/data; resulting checkpoint and snapshot
interfaces.rule: Uses the same atomic state/result/outbox transaction. Resume/close/new play effects require durable authorization first; immediate safety stop is the exception and must not wait for DB availability. Never report APPLIED from transport receipt alone. Repeated or interrupted execution is reconciled without replay.

interfaces.name: provide_photo
interfaces.input: image_id, metadata and owned JPEG bytes/file handle in private spool; source capture time
interfaces.output: job queued or explicit existing image error; eventual HTTP/image status
interfaces.rule: AI owns valid frame and encoding/profile; SDK owns bounded disk/queue, hashing verification, retry and HTTPS transfer. Commit photo-job intent with trigger; failure does not block guidance or closure.

interfaces.name: clock_and_output_ports
interfaces.implementation: AI real adapters; BACKEND fake adapters
interfaces.input: clock status sample; play(attempt_id,audio_asset_id), stop(attempt_id), setLED(on)
interfaces.output: ClockStatus evidence; start/completion/stop/failure/unknown callbacks with monotonic time
interfaces.rule: New play / LED-on requires local COMMITTED and a final live guard check. Safety stop / LED-off takes priority even when storage is delayed or unavailable. Immediate STOP APPLIED requires driver stop acknowledgement and durable state/result; scheduled STOP APPLIED means durable registration. Other commands use their own defined completion evidence. UTC/monotonic and physical A5 acceptance remain unchanged.

durability_rules: AI alone defines domain transitions; backend SDK alone implements local atomic persistence and transport. Backend cannot generate a successful AI decision or output result.
A durable local COMMITTED receipt is enough to continue local control; do not wait for broker PUBACK or server acks before output. Server acks only complete message delivery.
play(attempt_id) is at-most-once per persisted attempt; reserve before output. Duplicate commit must not replay it. Crash or uncertainty consumes the attempt as existing A5 specifies.
On local storage failure, no new automatic output; AI fault path stops current output using A5. Network/photo workers must not hold control-loop locks during slow I/O.
Runtime checkpoint, local_revision and operation_id are private internal data and are not added to the MQTT schema. device_seq remains the persistent network snapshot order.

Use one authoritative checkpoint encoding owned by AI with a version. Backend stores it atomically with contract projections and checks ID/count/version consistency; separate independently committed AI DB is prohibited.

local_revision increases only when an AI checkpoint/domain transition is committed; heartbeat and transport retry do not change it. device_seq is independently allocated durably by the SDK under the existing wire ordering rules.

Pending COMMITTED completion is not unconditional permission to play. Before a new output, AI rechecks the live stop generation and all current guards; a newer stop invalidates the old permit. See detailed SDK queue and recovery rules.

acceptance.pass: 서버 DB·REST/SSE의 사건 ID·상태·명령 결과가 공통 예제와 일치. 실보드 성능 통과로 표시하지 않음.

acceptance.scenario: 로컬 커밋 전/후 종료, 서버 ACK 유실, 같은 operation_id 및 message_id 재시도
acceptance.pass: 로컬 상태·outbox가 함께 남거나 함께 취소. 중복 부작용 없음. 재시작은 출력을 재생하지 않음.

acceptance.scenario: 늦은 RESUME, 중복 STOP, 실행 회신 누락, 만료·다른 사건 명령
acceptance.pass: 접수·실행·미확인을 구분. SDK가 성공을 만들어내지 않음. AI 대역의 실행 호출은 명령당 허용된 횟수만 발생.

acceptance.scenario: JPEG 업로드 실패·지연, 오래된 관측 snapshot과 새 heartbeat
acceptance.pass: 사진 실패가 사건 저장을 막지 않음. 이전 관측의 시각을 새 시각으로 바꾸지 않음. 정상 영상으로 오표시하지 않음.

acceptance.scenario: 브로커 차단·사진 지연·SDK 저장 불가 중 가짜 이동/STOP 입력
acceptance.pass: 네트워크 I/O가 제어 루프를 막지 않음. 새 출력은 영속화 성공 전 금지. 모의 응답시간을 실물 500ms 성능으로 주장하지 않음.

acceptance.scenario: 동일 SDK를 보드 런타임에 연결해 TLS·사진·명령·재시작·출력 및 저장 검증
acceptance.pass: AI가 버전·빌드·실행·물리 출력 증거 제공. 백엔드는 수신/복구 결과 대조. BC01~05 성공만으로 대체 불가.
